svg.font-family: 'Noto Sans SC', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', 'Source Sans 3', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', system-ui, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: Six Bloch spheres of the same size in two rows, each with a violet axis and an amber path of the turn; the grey dot is the start and the amber dot the end. X: 180° about the front-to-back x axis, north pole to south pole. Y: 180° about the left-to-right y axis, north pole to south pole. Z: 180° about the vertical z axis, |+⟩ on the equator to |−⟩ opposite. H: 180° about the axis halfway between x and z, north pole to |+⟩ on the equator. S: 90° about z, |+⟩ along the equator to |+i⟩. T: 45° about z, |+⟩ an eighth of the way round the equator.
